headline: U.S. fires a new wave of strikes on Iran and hits a tanker trying to skirt its blockade
summary: The US and Iran traded fire for a sixth consecutive day, with US strikes on Iranian command centres and missile sites. Iran targeted US bases in Gulf countries, and a US strike hit a tanker trying to skirt its blockade.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so conflict there is closely watched for supply and price risk.
why_moved: Ongoing strikes and attacks on tankers around the Strait of Hormuz raise concerns about disruption to Gulf oil shipments.
